plain: The grandson of the radio pioneer Guglielmo Marconi told the Italian magazine Oggi, in a video interview anyone can watch, "my grandfather had a lot to do with the UFO and ET issue", which would put Marconi inside a UFO effort in Mussolini's Italy of the 1930s. Michels brings this up himself, describing Oggi as a kind of Italian gossip magazine, roughly the equivalent of People.
